propositions: Plan-review attestations must encode the phase (planning or execution) under which the review was conducted, persisted in manifests and sidecar JSON, and passed through all validity/sign paths.
Execution-phase reviews enforce a fixed 0.80 priority-floor blocking threshold; planning-phase reviews preserve the stricter original threshold.
Compiled state maintains plan_review_phase (set by process_status winning transitions to in_progress/open or preserved otherwise) distinct from the signed phase in the manifest.

Phase compatibility validation must accept planning state with planning/legacy/execution signatures and execution state with planning/legacy signatures or execution signatures with floor >= 0.80; any syntactically valid floor < 0.80 in execution state is incompatible.

Pre-feature snapshots without plan_review_phase must bootstrap to planning (open/idea status) or execution (other known statuses) lazily via reducer cache versioning, emitting one INFO event and not appending ticket events.

Signing must collect an immutable generation transaction before the LLM/probe, retry at most three times only for HEAD instability, require exact generation match under lock, and return unsigned without writing on any failure (including LLM timeout, dirty tracker, or terminal stale generation).
